title: Battle of the Gabbard
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of the Gabbard", at revision 1370599654, opens: "The Battle of the Gabbard, was a naval battle fought from 2 to 3 June 1653 during the First Anglo-Dutch War. It took place near the Gabbard shoal off the coast of Suffolk, England, between fleets of the Commonwealth of England and the Dutch Republic. It resulted in a significant English victory." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2063617, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1653 battle of the First Anglo-Dutch War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
